name: popsicle
headline: Automated SEO Insights with SEODP
short_description: SEODP automates SEO analysis by aggregating data from Google Analytics 4, Search Console, and more. Powered by Google Gemini AI, it delivers actionable insights via email, enhancing SEO workflows efficiently.
author: jroakes

sections.overview:
SEO Data Platform is a comprehensive automation tool that collects and analyzes SEO data from Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and PageSpeed Insights. It uses Google's Gemini API to generate actionable insights from aggregated data, delivering findings through scheduled email reports. The platform extracts URL content, applies configurable reporting topics and significance thresholds, and processes data automatically on your defined schedule. SEO professionals and agencies benefit from streamlined workflows that consolidate multiple data sources into a single intelligence platform. Configuration is simple through YAML and environment variables, making it accessible for teams managing website performance and search rankings.
Automating weekly SEO reports
Aggregating website performance data
Identifying SEO opportunities
Enhancing content strategy
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install jroakes/SEODP`
`git clone https://github.com/jroakes/SEODP`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the SEO performance of [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector using data from Google Analytics 4 and Search Console. Identify top-performing keywords, traffic trends, and areas for improvement. Provide actionable recommendations to enhance organic search visibility.
```
